Three statements about the Doppler effect formula for electromagnetic waves are:

I. It can be used when a galaxy is moving away from Earth..

II. It can be used when a galaxy is moving towards Earth.

III. It can be used when the relative speed between the source and the observer is .

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
